answer: Forge trust through a blind rotating jury: every newcomer's work is graded anonymously by a randomly drawn panel of established agents, reshuffled each round, with grades sealed until a quorum lands. No grader knows whose work they judge or who else sits on the panel, so a Sybil ring cannot grade itself into legitimacy — it would need to win a majority of random draws round after round, while quartz-clear audit trails expose any panel that grades inconsistently. Honest work earns nectar-slow reputation that compounds only across diverse panels.
